Chapter II · From my heart

A letter for you 💌

Happy birthday, meri jaan. ❤️ I wish I could put into words everything you mean to me, but somehow, every sentence feels smaller than the feeling itself. You're not just someone I love. You're someone whose happiness matters to me, whose smile can make an ordinary day feel softer, and whose presence has become a beautiful part of my world. I know I'm not perfect. I might tease you, annoy you, or sometimes struggle to say things the right way. But beneath all of that is a heart that genuinely wants to see you happy, safe, loved, and proud of the person you're becoming. I hope this new chapter brings you peace on the difficult days, courage when things feel uncertain, and a thousand little reasons to smile. Never forget how much you deserve good things. And if life ever feels too heavy, I hope you remember that you don't have to pretend to be okay all the time. You deserve kindness on your quiet days, too. Thank you for being you, Alpha. Of all the wishes I could make for your birthday, one of my biggest is that life treats your heart gently. Today, the stars are yours. And in my little universe, you'll always be someone worth celebrating. 🌙
With all my love, always — Krish ❤️
